datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Sudan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets with IPC phase classifications, collection dates, and scenario information for January and February 2022.
